digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter architecture / shared code extraction
propositions: Extract Jira-family-general symbols (identity convention, absence-probe classifier, link vocabulary, value maps, field sanitizers) from adapters/jira/ into a new public shared package adapters/jira_family/ to replace unsanctioned private cross-adapter imports

Relocate identity.py whole, relocate probe.py's classifier taking resolved-status set as injected parameter while keeping RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES and probe() in adapters/jira/, and split jira_fields.py by symbol (outright moves for sanitizers/maps; parameterized moves for _sanitize_description/_sanitize_comment taking codec/limit as injected contracts)

Keep location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) in place and import relocated jira_family symbols via absolute paths, establishing dependency inversion (family imports from core; adapters/jira imports from family; never reversed)

Unify the three existing copies of local→Jira status/priority maps into a single definition in jira_family/, adopting the 'deleted': 'Done' entry from outbound_fields and config.py (fixing a latent bug where ACLI's deleted case fell through to invalid 'Deleted')
Re-point all importers and mock.patch targets to new paths with no re-export shims; acli*.py changes only import lines; J1's characterization oracle re-points one import but no assertions change

Enforce the import contract via a persistent AST-walk test that forbids modules outside adapters/jira[_datacenter]/ from importing jira_family, and jira_family from importing adapters/jira[_acli*]/, and require all imports into pinned modules to use absolute paths
